annotations.title: Save what an account is about

description: Save an account's niches (up to 3, one primary) and topics (up to 10), or the workspace default when account_id is left out. Each niche is a field (l1) and a sub-niche (l2) from niche_get's taxonomy; an l2 not on the list is saved as other with your words kept in l3. Add l3 for the specifics and audience for who it is for. Send niches, topics or both; what you send replaces the old list. A choice the person made in the app is never overwritten by an assistant: saved is false and kept names who holds it. Do not guess; run niche_suggest first or ask.

account_id.description: The account. Omit for the workspace default every account without its own uses

evidence.description: Why, e.g. the matched tags from niche_suggest

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

niches.description: Up to 3. An empty list clears them

audience.description: Who it is for, one line

l1.description: The field: medicine, fitness, wellness, nutrition, food, coffee, beauty, skincare, fashion, lifestyle, home, parenting, pets, travel, outdoors, sports, gaming, tech, photography, art, music, books, finance, business, education, science, comedy, cars, relationships, news_politics

l2.description: The sub-niche id from niche_get's taxonomy, e.g. anesthesiology. Anything unknown is saved as other with these words kept in l3

l3.description: Free text that narrows it, e.g. "case logging for CRNA students"

primary.description: The main niche. Send at most one; the first is primary when none is marked

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
